content.text: Core concepts that underpin all large-scale distributed systems — from consistency guarantees to scaling strategies.

items: Distributed Systems — Failure modes, coordination primitives, and distributed computing fundamentals
Consistency Models — CAP theorem, consistency guarantees, and choosing the right model
Scalability — Horizontal/vertical scaling, stateless design, and capacity planning
Load Balancing — Traffic distribution algorithms, health checking, and high availability
Caching — Cache hierarchies, invalidation strategies, and distributed cache patterns
Database Sharding — Partitioning strategies, shard key selection, and operational concerns
